MIND. [1] [Elaps]
Absence of mind.
Imagines he hears some one talking.
Depression of spirits, and desire for solitude.
Fearful and apprehensive of some fatal disease.
Fear of being left alone, as if something horrible might happen ; horror of rain.
Angry about one's self, does not wish to be spoken to.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Elaps]
Vertigo, with tendency to fall forward.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Elaps]
Severe stitching pains in forehead, with heaviness of head ; occasionally pain intermits from 8-10 days ; rumbling in left ear as of thunder, with impairment of hearing ; lachrymation of eyes, pain and redness of left eye.
Headache in occiput after mental exertion. θ Chronic naso-pharyngeal catarrh.
Frequent headache. θ Ozæna.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Elaps]
Completely blind in left eye for three years, and nearly so in right for three months, following headache ; now has severe headache with drawing, sometimes sticking pains from forehead to occiput ; pain at root of nose, with vertigo ; even with right eye can scarcely tell light from dark ; everything seems white, even at night ; some old rheumatic symptoms in legs. θ Amaurosis.
Eyeballs feel sticky under lids and as if rough.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Elaps]
Continued buzzing, as if a fly were enclosed in auditory meatus.
Crackling in ears on swallowing.
Dulness of hearing with buzzing in ears ; no pain ; slight discharge from ears, which leaves a green spot upon bed-linen ; consequent upon otorrhœa, from which he suffered during childhood.
Sudden deafness of right ear, after catching cold ; no pain, no tinnitus ; secretion of wax profuse but dry.
Hearing of both ears impaired ; otalgia of right ear.
Sudden painless attack of marked deafness at night, with constant roaring and cracking in ears.
Offensive discharge from right ear, with deafness on that side ; constant buzzing noise in diseased ear, subject to epistaxis and eruptions about nose and face ; skin hot and dry, but constantly complains of feeling cold ; pulse 120. θ Chronic otorrhœa.
Watery, yellow or yellow-green discharge with deafness.
Intolerable itching in ears ; watery yellowish discharge.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Elaps]
Stoppage of both nostrils.
Partial stoppage and stuffiness high up in nostrils, with dull aching in forehead ; < in wet weather ; occasionally bad smell from nose ; offensive discharge ; posterior wall of throat covered with a dry, greenish-yellow scab, wrinkled and fissured, extending up to nose ; nose-bleed ; pains from root of nose to ears on swallowing ; sneezing at night ; sense of smell gone ; profuse and dark catamenia. θ Ozæna.
Offensive discharge from nose ; subject to epistaxis and eruption about nose and face ; snuffles and pain from root of nose to forehead.
Discharge smelling like putrid herring pickle.
Coryza from least draft of air.
Blood black, flows in a steady stream, copious.
Epistaxis : sudden, profuse, while walking ; after a blow.
Nose bleeds when violently blown. θ Nasal catarrh.
Arterial blood gushes from nose and ears.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Elaps]
Face of a dull yellowish color. θ Ozæna.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Elaps]
Irritable throat, broken out with red blotches, about as large as half of a split pea ; blotches also extended over soft palate and sides of cheeks, and bled upon slightest irritation ; intolerable itching in ears.
Ulceration of throat, < left side, difficulty of swallowing liquids, occurring five or six times a year, lasting two or three weeks at a time ; attacks brought on by exposure to rain or wind ; dislikes wet weather apart from the throat affection, never feels happy in wet weather.
Exceedingly painful deglutition of both solids and liquids ; sharp pain and soreness to touch across chest from right to l. axilla ; frontal cephalalgia ; sides of throat sore to touch ; sides of buccal cavity above fauces covered with numerous dark-red points, like incipient pustules.
Deglutition of solids or liquids almost impossible ; throat exceedingly sensitive to touch ; tonsils swollen so that no passage is visible.
Dull pain from nares to ears ; when swallowing, pain goes to ears ; posterior wall of pharynx dry, mucous membrane fissured and covered with crusts ; offensive discharge from nose ; skin dry and hot, but always complains of feeling cold.
Sore throat, offensive discharge from nose, epistaxis, discharge offensive, smelling like putrid herring pickle ; posterior wall of throat covered with a dry, greenish-yellow membrane, wrinkled and fissured, extending to nares ; occasionally portions are detached and expelled from nose or mouth, leaving a raw, corrugated surface ; membrane dry and corrugated ; stuffiness about root of nose, and dull aching from there to forehead ; on swallowing, pain extends to ears ; sense of smell gone ; frequent headache ; face dull yellowish ; catamenia early, profuse, dark ; skin hot and dry, pulse 140. θ Chronic inflammation of naso-pharyngeal mucous membrane.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Elaps]
Canine hunger, yet unable to eat.
Violent thirst ; desire for sweetened buttermilk.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Elaps]
After drinking cold drinks lie like ice in stomach, and cause cold feeling in chest.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Elaps]
Cold drinks feel like ice in stomach ; weight at stomach after eating ; sinking, faint feeling at pit of stomach ; pain in stomach > by lying upon abdomen ; desire for sweetened buttermilk ; fearful and apprehensive of some fatal disease ; constipation.
Fruits and cold drinks lie like ice on stomach.
Burning in stomach. θ Phthisis.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Elaps]
Painful pressure in right side of liver.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Elaps]
Bowels constipated.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Elaps]
Red urine, with cloudy sediment.
Discharge of mucus from urethra. θ Phthisis.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Elaps]
Menses every 2 or 3 weeks ; flow profuse dark. θ Ozæna.
Black blood between menses.
Metrorrhagia ; discharge of very dark colored liquid and clots, but mostly liquid, and varies from half a pound to two or three pounds in twenty-four hours ; is so weak cannot rise from bed or hold anything in hand ; has the appearance of a corpse ; sensation of soreness across lower abdomen ; slight pain to urinate ; dragging pain in both temples ; at times slight pain in left pleura, almost always > by chewing a small piece of gum camphor.
Sensation as if something burst in womb, followed by a continuous stream of dark-colored blood, on attempting to urinate ; flow very profuse, venous, and containing some clots. θ Cancer uteri.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Elaps]
Complete aphonia ; sibilant rales, wheezing ; at night chokes and turns pale while sleeping ; soreness in throat below fauces on swallowing ; no respiratory sound in left lung, dull by percussion ; rales very distinct in right lung at each inspiration ; pulse 90, skin dry, but not hot.
Laryngeal phthisis.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Elaps]
Oppressed breathing in evening < on going up stairs.
Feeling of a heavy load on chest. θ Phthisis.
   

COUGH. [27] [Elaps]
Dry cough, frequent and constantly recurring paroxysms, after suddenly catching cold.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Elaps]
Very violent attacks of dry cough which terminate with expectoration of black blood, with severe tearing pain ; throughout chest, and principally at apex of right lungs oppression after having eaten. θ Phthisis.
Pain in right lung for eight days ; cannot turn to either side nor sit up without assistance ; sleeplessness ; sibilant rales with crepitation in both lungs ; right lung sounds dull under mamma and near armpit to percussion ; each inspiration causes a crackling sound ; respiration very difficult, almost agonizing ; vomiting all forenoon ; diarrhœa all day ; constant cough ; urine like blood. θ Pneumonia.
Pulmonary phthisis ; < in right lung ; rush of blood to chest and throat in morning.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Elaps]
Pulse 120. θ Ozæna.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Elaps]
Sharp pain and soreness to touch across chest, from right to left axilla. θ Sore throat.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Elaps]
Weight as of an iron bar pressing on small of back.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Elaps]
Transient stitching pains at one time above, at another below right knee ; < from motion or warmth of bed.
Icy cold feet.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Elaps]
Soreness of limbs < at night. θ Rheumatism.
   

NERVES. [36] [Elaps]
Sensation of numbness, with great weakness and coldness in whole left side of body ; deglutition impaired ; at times, darkness before eyes with vertigo ; dimness of vision ; lachrymation of right eye ; menses very scanty ; pain in right side of chest and right shoulder. θ Hemiplegia.
   

FEVER. [40] [Elaps]
Skin hot and dry, but constantly complains of feeling cold ; pulse 120. θ Chronic otorrhœa.
Flushes of heat in evening, with redness and heat of face and ears.
Skin hot and dry ; pulse 140. θ Ozæna.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Elaps]
Hemorrhages black, often fluid.
